pizzeria.title: The haunted pizzeria
pizzeria.alt: A hot pizza in a candlelit room with ghostly decorations.
pizzeria.description: Find a table in the old house and watch the wood-fired oven earn its keep. We set one extra place, as the family has since 1893. You are welcome to ask who it is for. The portrait will refer you to management. Settle in for a proper meal, or split a pie before a wander. The haunt is gentle; the ghost peppers are not.
pizzeria.access: Concept access: step-free entrance, flexible table seating, a quieter corner, and no surprise character visits at your table.

card.title: The haunted pizzeria
card.copy: A wood-fired supper. An extra place setting. A family business with a very complicated seating chart.
card.alt: A wood-fired pizza in a candlelit dining room, with ghostly shapes in the shadows.

hollow.title: Pumpkin Hollow
hollow.kicker: TAKE THE LONG WAY / YOUR PACE
hollow.alt: A glowing pumpkin-lined trail through autumn woods.
hollow.description: Follow the lanterns around a pumpkin patch maintained by Visitor Services, a department consisting of one rake and a handwritten rota. Before {{NIGHT_TIME}}, it’s a gentle woodland ramble. After {{NIGHT_TIME}}, the soundscape deepens and a few costumed residents come out to say hello. The pumpkins have been asked to remain in their assigned positions.
hollow.access: Concept access: firm, level surfacing, rest benches, and a shorter return path. No strobes, chasing, or touching. Real-world facilities have not been established.

card.title: A walk on the weird side
card.copy: A lantern-lit loop through our little patch of woods. All pumpkins have been briefed. Compliance varies.
card.alt: An autumn trail winding past glowing jack-o’-lanterns beneath string lights.

oddities.title: The oddities counter
oddities.alt: Ceramic ghosts and curious souvenirs arranged in an old wooden cabinet.
oddities.description: Some places keep a gift shop. We keep magnets with unresolved business. Browse six specimens from the family’s doubtful inventory: ceramic ghosts, old keys, postcards, a pumpkin pin, a returning magnet, and a raven from Accounts. The shelf labels record what we remember. None of it has survived an independent audit.
oddities.access: Concept access: a step-free counter with low display surfaces and space to browse slowly. The collection is for browsing only; curiosity is encouraged.

card.title: Proof you were here
card.copy: Six things the family cannot quite account for. Shelf labels supplied. Explanations pending.
card.alt: An old wooden curiosity cabinet filled with tiny ghosts, antique keys, and Halloween souvenirs.

faqs.question: How scary are we talking?
faqs.answer: Think cozy Halloween movie, not an endurance test. The dining room and oddities counter are low-scare spaces. After dark, Pumpkin Hollow adds eerie soundscapes and costumed characters. No touching, chasing, or strobe lighting is part of this concept.

faqs.question: Can I bring my little monsters?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. The golden hours, from {{DAY_RANGE}}, are designed for families and anyone who likes their spooky on the gentle side. Children stay with their grown-ups, and children under {{FREE_UNDER_AGE}} join the trail free.

faqs.question: What about access and sensory needs?
faqs.answer: The concept calls for a step-free dining room, accessible restroom, seating along the route, and a firm, level trail with a shorter return path. A quieter dining corner and a character-free daytime visit are part of the plan. These are design intentions for a fictional venue, not verified facilities.

faqs.question: Do I need a ticket just to eat?
faqs.answer: No. In this concept, the pizzeria, grounds, and oddities counter are free to enter. Food, drinks, and the optional Pumpkin Hollow trail are priced separately. The oddities collection is for browsing only. The visit builder helps estimate a trip; it doesn’t sell tickets or reserve tables.

faqs.question: What if the weather gets wicked?
faqs.answer: The pizzeria and oddities counter are indoors. The trail is outdoors and would close for unsafe weather. Bring a layer and shoes that don’t mind autumn. In the planner, you can skip the trail and still make a cozy evening of it.

faqs.question: Can you feed vegetarians and picky eaters?
faqs.answer: The menu includes vegetarian pizzas, plain cheese pizza for small appetites, and nonalcoholic drinks. Ingredients and dietary tags are shown in the full menu. A real kitchen would need to confirm allergies and cross-contact precautions; no item here is represented as allergen-free.

oddities.name: The Employee of the Month
oddities.alt: Ink illustration of a small ceramic ghost wearing an employee award.
oddities.copy: Awarded in 1958. Still on the counter. The family has stopped asking when its shift ends.
oddities.record: The building says it came with the staff. The staff say it came with the building. Neither has signed the inventory sheet.

oddities.name: Key to the Unlisted Room
oddities.alt: Ink illustration of an old brass key with a tag marked 13.
oddities.copy: The tag says Room 13. The floor plan stops at 12. Maintenance has filed this as a numbering issue.
oddities.origin: Front desk drawer, under “Do not file.”
oddities.record: Opens nothing we are currently advertising. A replacement lock has been ordered for a door we have not located.

oddities.name: Postcard from Next Thursday
oddities.alt: Illustrated postcard showing the haunted house beneath an autumn moon.
oddities.copy: A cheerful view of the house, signed by someone who has not arrived. Postage is your department.
oddities.record: The date keeps getting ahead of the postmark. We have asked the sender to allow three to five business days.

oddities.name: The Pumpkin’s Visitor Badge
oddities.alt: Ink illustration of an enamel pumpkin pin with a visitor ribbon.
oddities.copy: Issued to a pumpkin that requested a guided tour. It completed the feedback form. Mostly circles.
oddities.record: Visitor Services would like its badge back. The pumpkin would like to speak to the person who carved it.

oddities.name: Magnet with Unresolved Business
oddities.alt: Illustrated souvenir magnet depicting the house, with a receipt attached.
oddities.copy: Keeps returning to the invoice it came from. Excellent hold. Poor closure.
oddities.record: Removed from stock three times. Found on the purchase ledger four times. The discrepancy has been carried forward.

oddities.name: The Raven from Accounts
oddities.alt: Ink illustration of a black raven figurine perched on a small ledger.
oddities.copy: A small black raven guarding a very small ledger. Never promoted. Never off duty.
oddities.origin: The ledger shelf, since before the ledger.
oddities.record: It has approved no expenses since 1893. It has also approved no explanation for the extra place setting.
